custom/keepitnew.exec: if command -v keepitnew >/dev/null 2>&1; then keepitnew --waybar; else "$HOME/.local/bin/system-update" --waybar; fi
custom/keepitnew.on-click: if command -v keepitnew >/dev/null 2>&1; then keepitnew --open; else "$HOME/.local/bin/system-update" --open; fi
custom/keepitnew.on-click-right: if command -v keepitnew >/dev/null 2>&1; then keepitnew --reload; else "$HOME/.local/bin/system-update" --reload; fi
